hook.name: ElectFee
hook.description: A pool's swap fee is elected by its LPs. Each position states a fee ask (16 buckets, 0.05%–2%) in hookData on its first add. Swap fee = liquidity-weighted median ask, moved toward that median at max 10 pips/second. Only positions in range when first added are counted. Fees go to LPs via the PoolManager. Hook holds no funds, no admin, no external calls. Needs a dynamic-fee pool. Flags: afterAddLiquidity, afterRemoveLiquidity, beforeSwap.
